title: BurnCreepers
description: The plugin adds burning creepers during the day, making them vulnerable to sunlight, just like other hostile mobs. A great choice for those who are tired of creepers :3
body:
# **🔥BurnCreepers🔥**

The plugin makes creepers as vulnerable to sunlight as zombies or skeletons.

## ✔ Features:

- Sets creepers on fire in bright sunlight

- Works automatically and does not require any settings

- Minimal server load

- Supports Paper, Spigot, Bukkit, and Purpur

## Image:
![BurnCreepers Day](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/520c2297f533c9db93374f469a52264a91409f27.png)
## Commands (since version 1.1.0):

## Creepers
### /burncreeper on — turns on creeper burning during the day

### /burncreeper off — turns off creeper burning

### /burncreeper status — shows creeper burning status
## Spiders

### /burnspider on — turns on spider burning during the day

### /burnspider off — turns off spider burning

### /burnspider status — shows the status of spider burning
## On first launch

### /burncreepers = on 

### /burnspider = off
